New Book 'CLIFF' Launched in India on Economic Paradox of Longer Lives, Shorter Careers

Apricity Publishing has launched the global bestseller 'CLIFF' in India. The book addresses the emerging economic paradox where individuals are living longer but facing shorter career spans. This launch highlights discussions around financial planning and career longevity in the face of changing life expectancies.
